trust_decision.summary: install -D trusts that every component of the destination's parent path is a real directory and not an attacker-swappable symlink; this is decided implicitly in standard() by a path-based fs::create_dir_all followed by a path-based create of the destination file, both of which follow symlinks.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'install -D' and 'directory creation'; the only directory-creation call under b.create_leading is fs::create_dir_all here.
